reason: I'm not paying upfront when the core RPG progression and workout logging are completely free, especially since all-in-one apps usually feel bloated and slow. As an analytics nerd, I need to test if the UI is clean and whether the calorie and MET calculations are actually accurate before buying Pro.
objection: Fear that the app is bloated and sluggish trying to do lifting, 30+ sports, social feeds, and food tracking all in one, with superficial analytics instead of rigorous data.
would_change_my_mind: A snappy, minimalist UI with transparent MET formulas, precision macro analytics, and proof that the deep stat insights offer real scientific value.
